contract: ZFTVIA OCR Invoice API – final JSON contract for SAP Vendor Invoice Automation
owner: SAP ABAP team (ZFTVIA framework) / OCR application team
_comment_transport: Section 1 – HTTP transport. SAP calls the OCR API; the OCR application may also push finished PDFs to SAP (section 4).

transport.base_url_prd: https://<ocr-host>  (TLS mandatory in PRD, certificate imported in STRUST)

authentication.note: SAP stores the user name in table ZFTVIA_APICFG and the password AES-encrypted. Until Basic auth is live on the OCR side SAP can send an API key instead: header X-API-Key (AUTH_TYPE = APIKEY). Please keep ONE user per SAP system (DEV/QAS/PRD).

endpoints.name: result
endpoints.response_code_done: 200 with the full document below (status success | needs_review | error)
endpoints.polling_by_sap: every POLL_INTERVAL_SEC (default 3 s), at most POLL_MAX (default 40) attempts per run, retried by the SAP retry job afterwards

_comment_rules: Section 2 – data rules valid for every field.

rules.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, keys exactly as in the sample (snake_case, lower case)
rules.missing_values: Field not recognised on the document → JSON null. Never omit a mandatory key, never send empty string "" or "N/A" / "-" / "NULL" as text.
rules.dates: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD as printed on the document (SAP converts). If only month/year is readable send null and add it to additional_fields.
rules.amounts: JSON number with '.' as decimal separator, no thousands separator, no currency symbol (e.g. 1635.24, 36558.51). Negative amounts are NOT used – use document_type CREDIT_NOTE / document_direction instead.
rules.currency: ISO 4217 code, 3 upper-case letters (GBP, EUR, INR, USD). Convert symbols: £→GBP, €→EUR, ₹→INR, $→USD unless the document states another currency.
rules.vendor_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (GB, PL, IN, DE); derive from address or VAT-id prefix when not printed
rules.document_type: one of INVOICE | CREDIT_NOTE | DEBIT_NOTE | DELIVERY_NOTE | TIMESHEET | PROFORMA | STATEMENT | OTHER (upper case). Mandatory – SAP rejects the file otherwise. DELIVERY_NOTE / TIMESHEET are routed to NON_POSTABLE in SAP, so please classify packing lists, delivery notes and timesheets explicitly instead of OTHER.
rules.document_direction: VENDOR_TO_CUSTOMER (we pay) | CUSTOMER_TO_VENDOR (we issue) – helps to filter outgoing documents scanned by mistake
rules.line_items: one entry per physical line on the invoice in printed order. amount = net line value (before tax). Freight / packing / discount lines are ordinary lines with a telling description.
rules.additional_fields: every labelled value on the document that has no header field (Customer Order No, BL No, Container No, Vessel, Delivery Note, GRN, Vehicle Reg, HSN code, IRN, …). field_name = label as printed, field_value = value as printed. SAP matches names case-insensitively and configures the use per company.
rules.tax_details: one entry per tax type/rate (VAT 20, CGST 9 + SGST 9, IGST 18, reverse charge 0). Mandatory for India; recommended elsewhere.
rules.purchase_order_items: only when the document prints PO number + PO item per line (or a PO/line table). Otherwise an empty array [].
rules.confidence: 0.0 – 1.0 per header field (1.0 = certain). SAP routes a document to manual review when any mandatory field is below the configured threshold (default 0.80) or status = needs_review.
rules.multi_invoice_pdf: if one PDF contains several invoices (e.g. Arohan I2502786 – 3 invoices) return the FIRST invoice in this document, set document_count_estimate = 3 and add additional_fields {"field_name":"Additional invoices in file","field_value":"I2502787;I2502788"}. A split into separate PDFs by the OCR application is preferred.
rules.gl_account_cost_center_profit_center: always null – SAP determines account assignment itself (fields kept only for backward compatibility)
rules.vendor_bank_data: may be filled but SAP never updates vendor master from it; used only for an informational compare in the worklist
rules.error_status: status = error must come with "error": "<text>" and may leave invoice_header / line_items null

_comment_mandatory: Section 3 – field classification. M = mandatory (key must exist; value may be null only when it is truly not on the document, SAP then routes to review), S = should have, O = optional.

invoice_header.company_code: S (text printed as 'bill to' legal entity; SAP maps it)

_comment_sample: Section 4 – complete sample response of GET /api/v1/invoices/{id} (Brookshaw Stuart invoice 15915 against PO 6600128207, GBP, VAT 20 %).

invoice_header.vendor_address: Unit 4, Riverside Business Park, Rochdale, OL11 2PX, United Kingdom

_comment_samples_other: Section 5 – shortened samples for the other invoice kinds in the test pack.

sample_fb60_freight_header.line_items_note: freight / pallet hire lines – SAP classifies to FB60 by rule (vendor type FREIGHT or description pattern) even when a PO number is printed

sample_error_response.error: No text layer and OCR confidence below threshold

_comment_push: Section 6 – optional push from the OCR application into SAP (instead of SAP polling a mailbox). RFC-enabled function module, called via SAP RFC/JCo/NCo or SAP Gateway OData wrapper if preferred.

sap_push_interface.protocol: RFC (SAP .NET Connector / JCo / PyRFC) – user of type SYSTEM with role ZFTVIA_RFC

importing.IV_FILE_NAME: STRING – original file name, e.g. Brookshaw_15915.pdf
importing.IV_SOURCE_REF: STRING – unique reference of the source (mail message id / OCR job id) – used for duplicate detection
importing.IV_RUN_NOW: CHAR1 – 'X' = run OCR + validation synchronously, ' ' = queue for the SAP jobs

exporting.EV_VIA_ID: CHAR20 – SAP document id VIA-YYYY-NNNNNNNNN (returned also for a duplicate)
